name: Electronics enclosure with a screwed lid
brief: A small electronics enclosure: a 120 x 80 x 40 mm ABS base box with 2.5 mm walls, open at the top, four Ø8 mm screw bosses in the inside corners, and a flat 120 x 80 x 3 mm lid held by four M3 x 10 socket head screws into the bosses.
